subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
outcomes: I can name jobs and transport from Unit 4.
I can say: He / She goes to work by …
I can write about a family member's job.

tf.s: A doctor works in a hospital.
tf.why: Yes! A doctor helps people in a hospital.

tf.s: The underground goes on the road.
tf.why: The underground goes under the ground.

tf.s: We use He for a man and She for a woman.
tf.why: Right! Look at the person in the picture.

tf.s: We say: She loves his job. (about a woman)
tf.why: For a woman, we say her job.

tf.s: We say: She goes to work at seven o'clock.

tf.why: Yes! A train goes on rails.

tf.s: A firefighter is a kind of transport.
We say: He goes to work by motorbike.

boxes.q: Riddle: It's long. It goes under the ground. What is it?
boxes.why: The underground goes under the ground.

boxes.q: Riddle: I work in a hospital. I'm not a nurse. What am I?
boxes.why: A doctor works in a hospital.

boxes.q: Picture: a man on a boat. Circle: He / She goes to work by boat.
Circle: She loves his / her job.
Clock shows 7. Complete: She goes to work at ___ o'clock.

boxes.why: A police officer is a job.

boxes.q: Picture: a woman on a motorbike. Which sentence?
o: She goes to work by motorbike.
He goes to work by motorbike.
She goes to work by a motorbike.
boxes.why: A woman, a motorbike, no a after by.

hunt.q: Works in a hospital, not a nurse

mcq.q: How many jobs are in the word search?
mcq.why: There are ten jobs in the word search.

mcq.q: Which job is in the word search?
mcq.why: police officer is one of the ten jobs.

mcq.q: Which job starts with the letter b?
Riddle: I want to help people. I want to work in a hospital. I'm not a nurse. What am I?
mcq.why: A doctor helps people in a hospital.

mcq.q: Write about your uncle: he is a pilot and goes by car.
o: My uncle is a pilot. He goes to work by car.
My uncle is a pilot. She goes to work by car.
My uncle is an pilot. He goes to work by car.
My uncle is a pilot. He go to work by car.
mcq.why: a pilot, He goes, by car.

mcq.q: The notes say: Friday, Saturday. When does she work?
mcq.why: Friday and Saturday are the weekend.

mcq.q: Which clue tells you to circle He?
mcq.why: A man in the picture means He.

o: My mum is a teacher. He goes to work by car.
My mum is a teacher. She goes to work by car.
My dad is a chef. He goes to work by bus.
My sister is an artist. She goes to work by train.
mcq.why: Mum is a woman, so we need She.
